location_description:
Mullica Hill is a census-designated place (CDP) and unincorporated community in Harrison Township in Gloucester County, New Jersey. As of the 2010 United States census, the CDP's population was 3,982.


== History ==

Spicerville was the name of a community on the south bank of Raccoon Creek, named after prominent landowner Jacob Spicer.
